10Alytics is an Educational technology company that educates both individuals and corporate firms across Africa, the Middle East and Europe on the data and tech skills crucial for contemporary business practices. Our training programs cater to beginners, offering comprehensive guidance in both soft and technical skills, alongside top-rated employability sessions designed to enhance your professional profile. Having trained 70,000+ individuals across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, we are committed to supporting you on your learning journey. In addition to our training initiatives, our consulting team has assisted more than 70 organizations across Africa, Europe and North America in structuring their business data, establishing data warehouses, and implementing efficient processes enabling the identification of insights for strategic decision-making.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Finance Reporting Associate

Job Location: Remote

Job Description


	We are looking for a Finance Reporting Associate to support financial reporting, compliance, reconciliations, and day-to-day finance operations at 10Alytics.
	A key focus of this role is tax compliance and implementation.
	The ideal candidate must have a strong understanding of the Nigerian tax system and be able to translate tax requirements into practical processes within the organisation, ensuring timely filings, payments, accurate records, and ongoing compliance.


Key Responsibilities


	Manage and implement the organisation's tax compliance processes.
	Stay updated on applicable Nigerian tax laws, requirements, and regulatory changes.
	Prepare and/or coordinate tax calculations, filings, payments, and supporting documentation.
	Monitor tax deadlines and ensure timely compliance.
	Review transactions for appropriate tax treatment and identify potential tax risks.
	Prepare regular financial reports covering revenue, expenses, cash flow, and other key metrics.
	Reconcile bank accounts, payment platforms, and internal financial records.
	Track revenue, payments, outstanding balances, refunds, and installment plans.
	Support budgeting, forecasting, and budget vs. actual analysis.
	Maintain accurate and organised financial and tax records.
	Analyse financial data and provide insights to support business decisions.
	Identify opportunities to improve finance processes, controls, and reporting.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
	2–3 years of experience in finance, accounting, tax, or financial reporting.
	Strong practical knowledge of the Nigerian tax system is essential.
	Experience implementing or managing tax compliance processes is highly preferred.
	ICAN, ACCA, CITN, or relevant professional qualification is an advantage.
	Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills, including formulas, pivot tables, and reporting.
	Experience with accounting software such as QuickBooks, Xero, or Zoho Books is an advantage.
	Strong analytical, numerical, organisational, and problem-solving skills.
	High attention to detail and ability to work with confidential financial information.
	Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced

  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Sales & Marketing Executive - Hotel (Female & Male)",
  "description": "Stay and Homely Hotel Limited, a proud member of the esteemed DreamCity Group, is a luxurious retreat nestled in the tranquil surroundings of Maitama, Abuja. Our hotel offers a unique blend of boutique rooms, elegant apartments, and opulent villas, providing guests with an exquisite and unforgettable home-away-from-home experience. With a commitment to exceptional service and attention to detail, Stay and Homely Hotel Limited welcomes travelers to indulge in comfort, style, and sophistication, promising a stay that is both relaxing and memorable. Whether you seek a peaceful escape or a lavish getaway, our hotel is dedicated to ensuring that every guest&#39;s visit is nothing short of extraordinary.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Sales &amp; Marketing Executive - Hotel (Female &amp; Male)

Job Location: Maitama, Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry Type: Hotel &amp; Hospitality &amp; On-site

Position Overview


	We are seeking a skilled and motivated Sales &amp; Marketing Executive with 3&ndash;5 years of experience in the hospitality industry.
	The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing and executing sales strategies, driving occupancy and revenue, managing marketing campaigns, and building strong client relationships.
	This role is pivotal in positioning Stay &amp; Homely as the preferred hospitality brand in the market.


Key Responsibilities


	Execute effective sales strategies to achieve occupancy, revenue, and profitability targets for all properties.
	Prospect, qualify, and convert leads and new business opportunities, including corporate accounts, travel agencies, event organizers, and individual travelers.
	Build and maintain strong relationships with corporate clients, travel agents, event planners, and other key stakeholders to ensure repeat business and loyalty.
	Liaise with Marketing Team to Plan, execute, and monitor marketing campaigns across digital and traditional channels (social media, email, print, OOH) to increase brand awareness and drive bookings.
	Manage the company&#39;s website, social media platforms, PMS and online travel agency (OTA) profiles (Booking.com, Airbnb, etc.), ensuring content is optimized and engaging.
	Collaborate with the operations team to implement dynamic pricing strategies and promotional offers that maximize revenue and occupancy.
	Conduct market research to identify trends, competitor activities, and emerging opportunities, providing insights to refine sales and marketing strategies.
